Mapping population design

Source: R/mapping-population.R
mapping_population.Rd

A simulation spec for QTL mapping populations, so their design can be tuned on its own or later as one stage of a breeding program. Each replicate draws inbred founders, places one QTL of stated effect at a random position, builds the population by simulated meiosis, phenotypes the lines, scans the genome and records whether the QTL was detected.

Usage

mapping_population(
  type = "RIL",
  lines = 200L,
  families = 10L,
  backcrosses = 1L,
  generation = 6L,
  founders = "4",
  locations = 1L,
  reps = 1L,
  qtl_pve = 0.05,
  plot_h2 = 0.5,
  gxe_ratio = 0.5,
  n_background = 1000L,
  qtl_donor_freq = 0.5,
  n_chromosomes = 20L,
  chromosome_length = 115,
  marker_spacing = 1,
  scan_model = "auto",
  n_perm = 100L,
  alpha = 0.05,
  threshold = NULL,
  window = 10,
  scan_step = NULL,
  cross_cost = 25,
  ssd_cost = 2,
  genotype_cost = 20,
  plot_cost = 15,
  generations_per_year = 2L,
  max_plots = Inf,
  max_cost = Inf,
  max_years = Inf
)

Arguments

type

Population type (see above).

lines

Total lines phenotyped and genotyped.

families

Number of families (NAM and AB-NAM).

backcrosses

Backcross generations s (BCsFt and AB-NAM).

generation

Filial generation t at phenotyping (RIL, BCsFt, NAM, AB-NAM, MAGIC).

founders

MAGIC founders, "4" or "8".

locations, reps

Field locations and replicates per location.

qtl_pve

Variance explained by the QTL in a reference RIL.

plot_h2

Plot-basis heritability of the polygenic background.

gxe_ratio

Genotype-by-location variance as a multiple of genetic variance.

n_background

Number of background loci.

qtl_donor_freq

Probability a donor or MAGIC founder carries the QTL allele.

n_chromosomes, chromosome_length, marker_spacing

Genome (see sim_genetic_map()).

scan_model

"auto", "marker", "family_marker" or "haplotype".

n_perm

Permutations per replicate for the threshold.

alpha

Genome-wide type I error rate.

threshold

Fixed LOD threshold (skips permutations; much faster).

window

Distance in cM within which a peak counts as the QTL.

scan_step

Scan every scan_step cM instead of every marker.

cross_cost, ssd_cost, genotype_cost, plot_cost

Unit costs.

generations_per_year

Generations per year (field, winter nursery, greenhouse).

max_plots, max_cost, max_years

Budget limits; designs over them are infeasible.

Value

A mapping_population simulation spec.

Population types

Following R/qtl's BCsFt notation, with t the filial generation:

typeConstructionArguments used
"F2"Two founders -> F1 -> one selfing (phenotyped as F2:3 family means)lines
"RIL"Two founders -> F1 -> single-seed descent to Ftlines, generation
"BCsFt"Two founders -> F1 -> s backcrosses to founder 1 -> self to BCsFtlines, backcrosses, generation
"NAM"One common founder x families donors -> RILs in each familylines, families, generation
"AB-NAM"As NAM, with s backcrosses to the common parent in each familylines, families, backcrosses, generation
"MAGIC"4 or 8 founders intermated in a funnel -> self to Ftlines, founders, generation

lines is always the total number of lines, so designs with the same lines, locations and reps use the same field plots and compare fairly. F1 is generation 1: F2 is generation = 2, an F6 RIL is generation = 6, and BC1F3 is backcrosses = 1, generation = 3 (one backcross, then two selfings), matching the convention of breedsim's mapping-program.

QTL effect and genetic model

Traits are additive. qtl_pve is the share of single-plot phenotypic variance the QTL would explain in a biparental RIL in which it segregates, so its allele effect is the same in every design and realized variance explained differs by design (it is reported as realized_pve). In NAM and AB-NAM, donors carry the QTL allele with probability qtl_donor_freq; in MAGIC every founder does. A polygenic background of n_background loci gives the plot-basis heritability plot_h2, and genotype-by-location variance is gxe_ratio times the genetic variance, so more locations and reps sharpen line means.

Detection

A replicate counts as a detection when the LOD within window cM of the QTL exceeds the genome-wide threshold (permutations, or threshold). other_peaks records whether any other chromosome also exceeds it. With a polygenic background these are mostly real background loci (linked small effects add up in segments that recombination has not broken), so other_peaks rises with population size; with n_background = 0 it is a genome-wide false-positive rate, which the permutation threshold holds near alpha. See qtl_scan() for the models.

Costs and time

cost adds crosses, single-seed-descent plant generations, genotyping and field plots at the unit costs given (placeholders: replace them with your own). years is generations divided by generations_per_year, rounded up, plus one year for the field trial. max_plots, max_cost and max_years make designs over budget infeasible, so tuners skip them.

Examples

spec <- mapping_population(type = "RIL", lines = tune(), generation = tune(), n_chromosomes = 4)
spec
